title: How to Generate a Report
content: Open the Generate Report page. Select a territory, or choose All Borneo. Choose the optional report sections you want to include: Executive Summary, SDG Coverage, Coverage & Limitations, and Methodology & Sources. Review the report content, including the ESG Indicators section. Click Generate & Download PDF. If no indicators are available for the selected territory or data combination, the page reports that limitation instead of inventing unsupported content.
